title: Task Management Application
objective: Build a multi-view task manager with create/edit, priority/status, search, filters, validated forms, details routes, service-based state and tests.
scenario: Build a multi-view task manager with create/edit, priority/status, search, filters, validated forms, details routes, service-based state and tests. Build in milestones and keep every important behavior demonstrable.
target_skills: Components, forms, services, routing, promises, dependency injection, and unit testing.
skills: Components, forms, services, routing, promises, dependency injection, and unit testing.

milestones.title: Components, forms, services, routing, promises, dependency injection, and unit testing.
acceptance_criteria: Components, forms, services, routing, promises, dependency injection, and unit testing. behaves as documented and has repeatable verification steps.
A related empty, invalid, failure or cleanup state is handled where applicable.

required_features: Components, forms, services, routing, promises, dependency injection, and unit testing.
stretch_features: Add additional unit/integration coverage for critical workflows.
Document a compatibility, accessibility or operational trade-off.
Create a migration/retirement plan suitable for an unsupported framework.
tests_and_validation: Test the happy path, invalid inputs and empty data.
Check loading/failure/retry behavior for API-backed features.
Check keyboard access and accessible error/status messages.
Record the exact local setup, dependencies and commands.
Do not claim production deployment, live API access or a secure code runner was tested unless it was.

rubric.description: Required behaviors work and match the project brief.
Responsibilities and dependencies are clearly separated.
Empty, invalid and failed paths are considered.
Tests and manual checks are repeatable and documented.
Keyboard interaction, labels, focus and messages are reviewed.
No client-only authorization assumptions or secrets.
Setup, dependencies, limitations and next steps are recorded.

review_method: Human review plus project-specific automated tests; static token checks are not proof of behavior.
status_note: Based on the project brief in Section D of the supplied PDF; verify the selected starter environment before publishing.
